hint.label: Characteristics
hint.text: A characteristic is a feature of a living thing.

atoms.b: When living things ((++reproduce repurpose)), they pass on physical characteristics to their ((++offspring parents)). This process is known as inheritance.
Offspring ((++inherit lose)) many characteristics from their parents including eye colour, skin colour and height. This means that offspring usually look ((++similar different)) to their parents.

instruction.text: Look at this image. What characteristics has this girl inherited from her mother?

feedback.end: Characteristics like how you style your hair, what music you like or what clothes you wear are not inherited. These are environmental characteristics that you acquire throughout your life.

instruction.text: Drag these characteristics to the correct group.
Look at this image of a foal and its parent. Select the foal.
What characteristics has the foal inherited from its parent?
Look at this image of a calf and its parent. Select the calf.

hint.text: A baby elephant is called a calf.
hint.label: Calf

instruction.text: What characteristics has the calf inherited from its parent?
Look at this duck and its offspring. Do the duck and its ducklings look similar?

feedback.end: Sometimes, offspring can look quite different to their parents when they are young. When they become adults, they start to look more similar.

instruction.text: What similarities do these adult ducks now share with their parent?
